posts.text:
Your first step is free.

Take the readiness test: about 30 questions written for Australian practice, and a report of which areas to work on first. Then try everything for 7 days, no card needed.

Which topic worries you most right now: A) pharmacology or B) prioritisation? Reply A or B.

Link in bio.

#NCLEXRN #NCLEX #AHPRA #OBA #IQN #NursesInAustralia
